title: Generated LAYER MATERIAL graph output and retry control
scope: Register the existing generated dx_iface LAYER group-347 material-graph control as a focused CTest and record its current output/readback scope. No production behavior or support claim changes.

control.fixtureAdmission: The source DXF recipes and adapter models are locally generated at test runtime. Temporary drawings are removed after a successful run; no DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
control.proof: Inspect emitted LAYER group 347 against the exact MATERIAL output identity and owner dictionary, then import the generated DXF and check all four typed layer references. Control invalid/unresolved material handles, wrong owner/name/provider state, callback mutation, staged output edits and same-adapter retries.

limits: Generated source graph only; no physical producer conversion is included.
The control proves emitted identity and owner closure for this bounded adapter profile, not all MATERIAL graphs or native rendering.
